Share [...] #### What needs improvement

Security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy) aren't set by default. I only found out from an external audit and then had to add a _headers file by hand. A simple toggle or a recommended default in the site settings would help people who aren't developers.

#### vs Alternatives

My portfolio runs on WordPress.com, and I also have shared hosting with cPanel. For the app's website I wanted something simpler: a static site I could upload as a package of files and update without managing a server or a CMS. Netlify fit that exactly, and the custom domain setup was easy.
